Lina Gomez (AE): Prospect just requested a completed CAIQ + a one-page shared-responsibility table for their security board. POC will be run next week. Can we assemble quickly.
Harper Nguyen (GRC): I can drive CAIQ answers. First question: where will the POC run?
Ethan Cho (Solutions Eng): SOW indicates customer account (VPC) with Redwood agents. They asked to demonstrate BYOK + auditability.
Nora Kim (SE): Quick facts: when POC runs in customer account, infra logs (CloudTrail, VPC Flow) are theirs. Redwood runtime logs are ours unless they configure a forwarder.
Harper Nguyen (GRC): Noted. Also need to call out SOC2 evidence path if they request it for POC timeframe. We must route via Evidence Portal.
DevOpsBot: Ticket created: CAIQ-3021 assigned to Harper Nguyen. Link: https://redwood.app/internal/CAIQ-3021
Lina Gomez (AE): Procurement asks for ballpark cost of a 2-week Dedicated burst + BYOK integration. Can someone provide a rough band?
Ethan Cho (Solutions Eng): I'll provide pricing bands today. Add-on estimate for BYOK integration (if they require non-standard HSM) included as contingency.
Nora Kim (SE): Potential blocker: external (non-AWS) HSM integration is not on our fast path; will need ops runbook and ~3-5 days of work. Call that out.
Harper Nguyen (GRC): Action items: Harper will draft CAIQ answers + shared-resp page; Nora to supply log/ownership wording and a sample IAM snippet; Ethan to add pricing band; deliverable by EOD tomorrow.
Lina Gomez (AE): Thanks. Also include a short fallback note: if Dedicated capacity isn't available we can route requests to Hosted with reduced SLA.
DevOpsBot: Reminder - any SOC2 evidence requests must go through Evidence Portal: https://redwood.app/evidence
Harper Nguyen (GRC): Adding retention default: 90 days for runtime telemetry, configurable per agreement. Will note cost implications for 180+ days.
Ethan Cho (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a tiny Terraform example for IAM role binding in the CAIQ appendix (illustrative only).
Lina Gomez (AE): Perfect. I'll notify the buyer of the timeline and ask for any mandatory HSM requirements ASAP. :thumbsup:
